Vouch World: a simulated agent economy in SpacetimeDB, CREAO agents that investigate refund claims and confirm fraud patterns, and a fenced Factory Droid lab that writes detectors.
Start with README.md, then AGENTS.md (rules for coding agents), PROGRESS.md (acceptance tests and evidence), docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (code map).
What is live versus simulated: docs/REAL_VS_SIMULATED.md. Checked facts: docs/VERIFIED.md. Live steps still to run: docs/LIVE_CHECKLIST.md.
Do not trust a claim without checking the file or command named beside it.
